name: Bannari Amman Spinning Mills Ltd
summary: Bannari Amman Spinning Mills Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the textile business in India and internationally. It manufactures and markets cotton yarns, woven and knitted fabrics, home textiles, and knitted garments, as well as processes fabrics. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Coimbatore, India. Bannari Amman Spinning Mills Ltd is a subsidiary of Murugan Enterprise Private Limited.
